products.name: Ureteral Dilator Set
products.description:
The  Ureteral Dilator Set is a critical component in urological procedures. It is specifically designed for effective and atraumatic dilation of the ureter prior to ureterorenoscopy.  

SAM INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS Ureteral Dilator Set can be used for accessing the upper urinary tract or to facilitate the passage of instruments for stone manipulation. This set ensures a smooth and safe procedural flow. Patient safety is a high priority. To reduce the risk of trauma and procedural complications, it allows for sequential dilation of the intramural tunnel and the ureter. If your procedure requires pressure-controlled dilation, you can also explore our Ureteral Balloon Dilators for an inflatable alternative for precise and radial tract enlargement. 

Simplify the process of accessing the ureter and renal pelvis during endoscopic interventions. With a range of tapered dilator designs, it can gently expand the ureter so that there is minimal resistance.  

Key Applications 

Dilation of the ureter prior to ureterorenoscopy (URS) 

Sequential dilation for smoother instrument access 

Pre-stenting procedures 

Preparation for stone manipulation or retrieval 

Navigating narrow or tortuous ureteral pathways 

 

The Ureteral Dilator Set from SAM INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS is available in a wide range of sizes. With sizes 6 Fr - 16 Fr and each dilator in a standard length of 70 cm, you can rely on its consistent and reliable performance. It is trusted by urologists and healthcare providers worldwide and backed by quality control and clinical validation.

SAM INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS manufactures an array of medical devices used in various medical procedures. Our Nephrostomy tube is widely used in Urology processes for draining fluid, and it can also be used as a self-catheterisation catheter.
                    
                    Sometimes, urine flow is blocked into the bladder due to stones, infection, congenital abnormalities, or trauma. Often a nephrostomy tube is inserted from the lower back into the kidney to ensure the flow is maintained. The urine will then pass through these pipes and get collected in a bag.
                    
                    The radiologist will locate the kidney with the help of a live X-ray and then insert a special hollow needle through the skin into the kidney. The end part of the catheter which is outside the skin is attached to a bag to collect urine. Our nephrostomy tubes are available in 30-40cm length and available in various sizes like 12Fr,14Fr, 16Fr, 18Fr, 20Fr, 22Fr, 24Fr, 26Fr, 28Fr,30Fr

The Jejunal Feeding Tube is a soft plastic tube inserted through the skin of the abdomen to the jejunum which is part of a small intestine. This procedure is entirely carried out during the endoscopy. Jejunal tubes are prescribed for patients who have gastro intestinal problems, pancreatitis and severe acid reflux. These tubes are safer and less expensive when compared to other feeding tubes. 

The main purpose of Jejunal tube is supplying nutrition and medicines to the patients who cannot take it orally. The tube can be placed in the patient’s abdomen till the conditions improve. Jejunal tubes should be flushed every 4 to 6 hours using sterile water to avoid the entering of pathogens into the feeding tube. The tube should be removed when there is an occurrence of blockage.
